path.description: Its folder or file, when it has one (a project's mount).

harness.description: A session's worker: claude, codex, copilot, opencode.

session.description: A session's own id in its harness (Claude Code's session id), what its transcript is filed under.

live_session.description: The live session a session is shared in right now, when it is.

room.description: A project's active collaboration room, when it has one.

plan_path.description: The plan a session wrote (its file path): the Plan screen opens it as vfs/<path>.

provider.description: A data source's driver (rss, telegram, gmail ...): its driver page is drivers/<provider>.
